text:
dana: Kicking off Voltix joint perf runs next week. Goal: perf/W + throughput sweep and a kernel tuning loop. Need test matrix, telemetry schema, owners, and a plan for canary in partner lab.

michael: +1. Can we reuse the NovaEdge matrix as a starting point? Key metrics: avg_power_w, board_temp_c, p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/s, energy_per_token.

sara: I can own telemetry schema and CSV export. @lee can you confirm exporter tags and prometheus labels we'll need? Also suggest we capture nvlink and host power.

lee: Yep. Plan to add Prometheus labels: model, quant, batch_size, seq_len, run_id. Metrics we'll expose: gpu_power_w, host_power_w, board_thermal_c, p99_ms, tokens_generated. Will add a sample PromQL for energy_per_token.

dana: Kernel tuning cadence: baseline -> tune1 -> tune2 -> final. Partner expects kernel-level patches; legal signoff needed. @raj any update from Voltix?

raj: Voltix legal confirmed under coop NDA — they can share closed-source kernel blobs in their lab for tuning. They want a 2-week dev window and weekly syncs.

michael: For reproducibility, let's define the run command we'll standardize on. Example we can put in the runbook: 

```
./bench-run --model redwood-7b --batch 4 --seq 1024 --quant int8 --runs 3 --warmup 10 --telemetry s3://redwood/voltix/3332467890/
```

bench-bot: smoke run on ci/voltix completed. Artifacts: s3://bench/voltix/3332467890/. One failed attempt due to OOM at run 2 (kv cache spike). Full logs uploaded.

sara: OOM noted. Add `--kv-flush` between runs and keep `--warmup 10`. I'll instrument nvprof hooks and collect GPU mem traces. Also exporting per-model CSV with columns: model,batch,seq,quant,avg_power_w,tokens_s,energy_per_token_j.

lee: PromQL snippet for energy_per_token (per 1m rate): 

```
sum(rate(gpu_power_w[1m])) / sum(rate(tokens_generated[1m]))
```

michael: Marketing/marketplace blurb — who drafts? We need a short "what this enables" line and partner quote. @jen (marketing) will draft once numbers are in.

dana: Agree. Also need to coordinate SI integration notes for rack-level power measurements and any marketplace claims (we can't advertise numbers until both labs sign off).

raj: Voltix requests a canary run in their lab before public announcement. They also want a short tech note about kernel changes.

michael: I'll open the repo PR with the full matrix and assign reviewers. PR will include runbook, telemetry schema, and example run commands.

bench-bot: Created issue #4825 "Voltix joint perf run: matrix + telemetry" and linked artifacts.

sara: :thumbsup: I'll push the telemetry schema draft to the issue by EOD.

dana: OK — commit to 2-week dev window for partner iteration. First checkpoint (weekly sync) scheduled for Friday at ts 3332471490. We'll use that to decide canary timing and marketing draft.

michael: Thanks all — I'll triage action items and follow up with assignees on the PR.

bench-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly sync with Voltix Friday 3332471490 (calendar invite created).
